messages:
Matt (customer): Hey team, we're seeing occasional truncated streaming responses from the Python SDK. The iterator yields an empty chunk as the final item and then stops — missing our final 'done' delta. Happens ~1-2% of calls, hard to repro locally.

Elle (support): Sorry you're hitting this, matt. Can you paste the request_id and a short repro? Any recent env changes?

Matt (customer): request_id=rid_8a7f2c. Repro: long generation (~10k tokens). Using python sdk v2.4.1 with httpx/httpcore from pip. Sometimes the last SSE frame (the event with {"done":true}) never arrives to the iterator; iterator yields b'' or an empty string then StopAsyncIteration. Curl streaming against our same request (via proxy to Redwood) shows the done frame present.

Elle (support): Interesting. So the wire has the done frame, but python client misses it. Could you capture a raw tcp dump or enable httpx debug logs?

Matt (customer): Attached minimal debug excerpt:

[log]
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

data: {"delta":"hello"}

data: {"delta":"..."}

(data frames...)

(data: {"delta":"..."})

data: {"done": true}




(EOF)

But Python client log shows: last read -> b''; parser -> stop; no 'done' event parsed.

Elle (support): Thanks. Looping eng/runtime and infra. @Sam @Ingrid can you triage?

Sam (eng-runtime): Noted. This smells like a regression introduced when we switched httpcore streaming behavior in the client dependency bump last month. If curl sees done but python misses it, either the httpx iterator yields empty chunk prematurely or our SSE parser treats a zero-length read as EOF and doesn't flush buffered events.

Ingrid (eng-infra): I'll pull the raw proxy logs for rid_8a7f2c. Also checking if any keepalive/middlebox closed the connection — but since curl saw it, more likely a client-side race.

ci-bot: New issue created: RNF-4283 \"py-sdk: final SSE event occasionally lost -> empty chunk StopIteration\" (priority: high). Link: https://tracker.internal/issue/RNF-4283

Sam (eng-runtime): Short repro (python) that hits the behavior locally for us with a simulated delay:

```python
# repro.py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    async with AsyncClient() as client:
        it = client.stream("/v1/generate", json={"model":"rwd-xl","prompt":"long..."})
        async for chunk in it:
            if not chunk:
                print("EMPTY CHUNK -> break")
            print("got", chunk)

asyncio.run(main())
```

Sam (eng-runtime): On our side, adding extra logging shows httpcore sometimes returning b'' from an internal read while there's buffered bytes that haven't been emitted as events (split across TCP packets). Our SSE parser interpreted b'' as EOF and closed the generator before flushing.

Elle (support): Customer impact: partial outputs can break downstream workflows and may cause double billing if retries occur. Matt, we will disable automatic client-side retry for your org for now and flag billing protection.

Matt (customer): Thanks, please do. We saw one double-run last week.

Ops Oncall: Temporarily disabled client auto-retry for org-222 (matt's org). Noted for billing team.

Sam (eng-runtime): Proposed fix: treat a zero-length read as \"transient\" if there is an unterminated SSE event in the parser buffer; only treat it as EOF when subsequent socket read also returns b'' or socket closed. Add unit that simulates split chunks and zero-length reads.

Ingrid (eng-infra): Also looking at load balancer timeouts — there's a recent change that enabled TCP keepalive probes which can produce zero-length reads in some httpcore versions. Will coordinate with runtime to validate.

Sam (eng-runtime): Can you share python package versions (httpx, httpcore) you get via `pip freeze`? We suspect httpcore>=0.17.5 behaves differently.

Matt (customer): pip freeze: httpx 0.24.0, httpcore 0.17.6, redwood-sdk 2.4.1.

Sam (eng-runtime): Ok that matches our repro. Temporary workaround: pin httpcore==0.17.4 and restart your worker — that avoided the empty-chunk behavior in our tests. We'll ship a client-side patch that is resilient to these reads in the next patch release.

Elle (support): Next steps for us: 1) Provide a small test harness and logs collection steps for you (matt). 2) Patch in client (sam) and cut 2.4.2. 3) Infra (ingrid) validate LB keepalive change doesn't worsen the issue. 4) Billing/ops to review org double-run refund.

Sam (eng-runtime): Assigned RNF-4283 to me. I'll open a PR with parser fix + new unit tests. Draft PR: https://git.internal/rnw/runtime/pulls/512 (WIP).

Matt (customer): Happy to validate a pre-release wheel if you want us to test at scale. Appreciate the fast triage.

Elle (support): We'll DM a test wheel and a short checklist. Thank you all — staying on this until resolved. :thumbsup:

(ci-bot): RNF-4283 updated: labels=bug,high,root_cause_candidate

Sam (eng-runtime): Quick note: if anyone else sees similar reports, ask for `httpcore` version and raw SSE lines captured with `REDWOOD_HTTP_DEBUG=1` — that will speed repro.

Elle (support): Closing Slack loop for now; will post updates in the issue and tag this thread when 2.4.2 is released.
